what: Pin the section to the screen and push a card strip horizontally. The first 15% of the pin rests on the first card, over the next 70% each card moves straight by xPercent −100 × (section count − remaining) plus an x offset, and the last 15% rests on the last card (scrub 1). Pin length is section width × len + viewport height × .8 × 2. Created 300ms late so measuring happens after the previous section’s pin has settled

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Slide cards (several) — each card gets an xPercent, so widths must match to stay even
options.[data-fx-part=track]: (if present) card strip — fx.css lines it up horizontally
options.keep · keep-narrow: Number of cards left on screen at the end, default 2 · phone keep (original wide screen 2 · phone 1)
options.x · x-narrow: Extra px pushed at the end (wide screens as is, phones × (card count − 1)) — original −48 · 27
options.len · len-narrow: Fixed length multiplier (panel width × len), default 3 · phone len (original 2.5)
options.buffer: Screen-height share added to the rest before and after, default .8 (× 2)
